correctness.rationale: For one positive lower quota L at a, the global feasibility slack is n-[L+(n-s)t] until an object a quota is filled. Hence if s>=L no restriction before time 1; otherwise the only breakpoint is tau=(n-L)/(n-s), and non-a-first agents receive tau at reported favorite plus 1-tau at a. Any unilateral report ranking a first gets a surely; a report ranking another first preserves s and tau and substitutes an object weakly worse than truthful top. This proves full first-order stochastic-dominance strategyproofness for all stated n,m. With two minima, the explicit 3-by-3 profile (A>B>C,A>C>B,C>B>A) and report C>A>B for agent 2 yields utility gain 5/12 for (uA,uC,uB)=(12,11,1). Two-object SD is a complete lottery order and weak strategyproofness excludes improvement; with n=2 both unit minima exhaust feasible demand and exclude other objects, establishing minimality. An independent exact Fraction event-integrator exhausted 216 strict profiles and all 3*5 alternative reports: 30 vulnerable, 36 profitable triples, multiplicities 186/24/6. The enumeration is finite only; the universal single-minimum assertion rests on the analytic formula.

value.rationale: A sharp distinction between weak and full stochastic-dominance truthfulness is consequential for fairness and incentive analysis. The minimal 3-agent/3-object quota witness and exhaustive 30/216 incidence quantify how a second positive lower quota changes incentives. This is neither a renaming of generic weak strategyproofness nor an arbitrary chosen profile: it is a natural smallest failing boundary.
